Subject: Handoff: AstraFleet pilot — SOW, tech notes, and kickoff window

Marissa —

Quick handoff for AstraFleet (closed this morning). High-level: 3-month pilot, $250k committed spend if acceptance criteria met, target go-live for the pilot is 2028-10-15. They signed last night; procurement will run DocuSign this week.

What's in this thread: deal context, SOW v1, a short network topology from their infra lead, and a HubSpot record (link below). Please pick a CSM and lead eng for implementation. Key asks from the customer:
- Pilot goal: reduce aggregate inference latency for their chat assistant and enable multi-region failover.
- Data residency: logs must remain in us-west region for pilot; long-term requirement TBD.
- Auth: SAML is mandatory for admin UI.
- Acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 1k qps synthetic load, and basic API integration test passing.

Attachments: [attachment: AstraFleet_SOW_v1.pdf], [attachment: network-topology.png] (network diagram from Priya).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 (deal RDW-2028-1743)
DocuSign incoming: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/rdw-2028-1743

Internal notes for CS/Eng:
- Primary customer contacts: Liam Chen (PM) and Priya Rao (CTO). Procurement loop: procurement@astrafleet.com.
- Billing is direct with finance — finance@astrafleet.com (will be CC'd on the contract).
- Environment access: they will provide a staging account and a service account with scoped tokens. Request those before kickoff.

Risks flagged by AE: SAML integration typically needs coordination with their IdP team (Priya flagged Okta). Also they asked about on-prem networking for peering later in the pilot.

Next steps I recommend:
1) CSM schedules internal kickoff with Eng and Solutions to align on scope and timeline.
2) Request staging credentials and SAML metadata before 9/22.
3) Draft pilot runbook and acceptance tests.

Thanks — I can jump on the internal kickoff to run through the commercial details if helpful.

Karthik Iyer

- Internal kickoff (Redwood internal only): 2028-09-20 11:00 AM PT — align owners and clarify technical ramp.
- Customer kickoff (introductions + scope alignment): week of 2028-09-25; proposed slots: Tue 9/26 morning PT or Thu 9/28 afternoon PT.

Before the customer kickoff, we need the following from AstraFleet:
- Staging credentials and service account tokens (scoped)
- SAML metadata for Okta test tenant or test user account
- A list of sample prompts and a small evaluation dataset for acceptance testing

Ben — can you confirm tentative resource plan (1x implementation PM, 1x infra engineer for peering/SAML, 1x solutions engineer for API integration) and rough timeline to first integration spike? If SAML + peering are both required, we should budget two 3-hour deep-dive sessions with their IdP and networking teams.

I’ll own the pilot runbook and acceptance criteria doc. I’ll draft the runbook and share a link by 9/18.

On quoting: once procurement signs SOW, finance will set up billing cadence. Karthik — please loop procurement when DocuSign is ready.

Best,
